reviews.title: Excellent next gen motherboard with plenty of options.
reviews.comment:
Received this bad boy yesterday in the mail. Received all the parts I ordered from Amazon and started the build.
Added an Intel Core Ultra 7 265K, and 64GB of Crucial Pro 32GB DDR5 RAM Kit x 2 and a Samsung 990 Pro 1TB NvMe for storage. Attached the cooler and mounted the board in the Thermaltake View 270 Plus. PS was a Thermaltake GF1 750W. It started right up with zero issues. The board has plenty of expansion capabilities, including 3 additional M.2 connectors for more storage. It also features a PCiE 5th Gen slot for a Video card and special removal bracket to pop the card out when you want to. Installed Windows 11 Home and the system runs very fast and smooth. I am very happy with my purchase. First new build for myself in many years. Finally something cutting edge for myself. Will purchase a new Asus Nvidia GeForce 5050 card soon and add that in. Right now running onboard graphics from the motherboard to a single monitor. I would definitely recommend this motherboard. Oh,  and I also updated the BIOS as soon as all the Windows Updates were done. Asus EZ-Flash Utility and it accepts .zip files for that. No issues at all.Running smoothly.
reviews.author: Pieter Roelofse

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.comment:
Over the past few weeks, I had two Z890 motherboards that were dead on arrival.  The first one would not see the drives. I Worked with Asus support for days and was finally told to return it, as it did.
Ordered another Prime Z890-P and this time the motherboard would not power up. Got a flashing power light and never got any video. I contacted support again and again and was told by support to return the motherboard.
Now I have an Intel Prime CPU, DDR 5 chips etc. and I don’t know what I am going to do. What a mess.  I have been building computer for years and have never had this problem before. My current build is a Asus Prime Z490-A that I built years ago and is still running great.
Very disappointed
reviews.author: Nadine
